proposal: The Mandate says the next Administration arguably should place its nominees in acting roles in similar positions while they await confirmation, such as serving as senior official performing the duties of the CBP Commissioner. It recommends legislation removing the confirmation requirement from lower-level DHS posts, including FEMA posts other than the Administrator, and setting a durable, politically oriented line of succession in which a career employee holding a leadership post is treated as vacant for succession purposes and acting Secretaries have explicit authority to finalize agency actions.

status_summary: On 2025-01-20 Executive Order 14148 revoked the prior administration's Executive Order 14135 on the order of succession within DHS. The same day a career CBP official, Pete Flores, was serving as senior official performing the duties of the CBP Commissioner, and by April 2026 the ICE director post had gone without a Senate-confirmed occupant since the Obama administration, with an official performing the director's duties who announced his departure effective 2026-05-31. No bill on DHS succession or on removing Senate confirmation from DHS posts was found, so the legislative parts remain unaddressed.

timeline.event: Executive Order 14148 was signed and, in section 2(kkk), revoked Executive Order 14135 of 2025-01-03, which had provided an order of succession within DHS.

Pete Flores, a career CBP official, was serving as Senior Official Performing the Duties of the Commissioner of CBP and signed a CBP memorandum on ending catch and release, per a policy tracking site summary of the memo.

title: Use acting officials, set a political line of succession, cut Senate-confirmed DHS posts
uncertainties: Executive Order 14135, revoked by 14148, was itself an order of succession; whether DHS issued a replacement order was not found, so the revocation may only return DHS to the statutory default and is not shown to match the Mandate's political-only succession. The CBP acting role rests on a tracking site summary of an image of a memo. The NPR article, read for ICE, does not say when the acting ICE director began, who follows, or that anyone was a nominee placed as acting; use of actings is therefore a parallel executive practice, not shown to be the Mandate's nominee-as-acting method. Confirmation of CBP Commissioner and other acting practices at TSA, CISA and FEMA were not researched. Searches for 119th Congress succession bills found none.
